anyOf.title: VLM role in a non-template profile
anyOf.$comment: Draft v0. Describes the final form of vlm.roles.<name> (contracts/vlm-request.md). Template sentinels such as fit_from_gt are refused by the loader before this schema applies. Ranges are the schema's own bounds, not engine limits. The role's image field is none or an object that names the image source and where size and encoding come from (the configuration profile block vision).

anyOf.description: Longer side in pixels after a downscale that keeps the aspect ratio and never upscales; `none` sends the original image; `from_vision` takes `vision.max_image_side` (decision 84)

data_root.description: For kb sync, a resolved path that does not overlap knowledge.root.
